categories.kit-fix: A bug fixed in the kit. The live claude-code-lua-plugin is being sunset and is never patched, so the fix shows up here as a declared difference from the 1.16.0 baseline.
categories.kit-consistency: One canonical value or rule for every host, decided in the kit (see NOTES.md).

plugins/lua-agent-builder/lib/hook-runti.reason: one multi-host runtime on every host; isMainScript compares real paths, so a plugin path through a symlink no longer turns every hook, the deploy gate included, into a no-op

plugins/lua-agent-builder/lib/host.mjs.reason: resolveHost() and the per-host protocols the shared runtime renders through

plugins/lua-agent-builder/lib/host-defau.reason: the emitted default host (claude-code) and its empty fail-closed list

plugins/lua-agent-builder/hooks/block-au.reason: matches lua, heylua, lua-ai and lua-cli, through launchers, paths and shell strings; `\blua\s+` missed `heylua auth configure` and `lua-ai auth configure`

plugins/lua-agent-builder/lib/lua-bin.mj.reason: the one pattern for a lua-cli invocation under any of its names, shared by the credential hooks

plugins/lua-agent-builder/test/hooks/blo.reason: every alias, launcher and path form is blocked; the alias list is checked against the deploy classifier

plugins/lua-agent-builder/hooks/hooks.js.reason: one timeout per hook on every host: confirm-deploy 30 s (was 10 s here, 30 s on Codex), because a timed-out gate fails open

plugins/lua-agent-builder/test/lib/hook-.reason: runs the gate through a symlinked plugin path and proves it fires
